source_findings.detail: Local positive cases check key cardinality and side membership, encoder count, and logical hub identity. They do not prove each reconstruction key pair denotes the same original source column or that encoders are wired to the compared keys.

All generated joins start without equi-keys and accepted residuals do not depend on a left column or called subplan. Preservation of existing equi-key pairs, left residual renaming and accepted subplan captures is not exercised.
Local LeftSemi/LeftOnly/zero-column cases verify rewriting shape only. They do not establish physical compilation, output projection or query bag semantics for those forms.
The producer-guard case observes the unchanged logical producer and its nonduplicability. It does not run sharing expansion or stage admission and cannot prove runtime acceptance without spilling.

The live physical check recognizes a multi-output Switch but does not bind it to reconstruction keys. The separate dormant probe deliberately cannot grant exact origin or aggregate-value lineage proof.
